ui.form.title: Map your project
ui.form.lede: Answer the questions at your own pace. Anything you do not know yet can be marked to be clarified later. At the end you download one pack with your answers.
ui.form.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. Turn JavaScript on in your browser and open the page again.
ui.form.err.start: The form could not start in this browser. Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
ui.form.privacy.title: Your answers stay with you
ui.form.privacy.text: Nothing leaves your computer. The page runs entirely in your browser and the pack is built here. Your answers are stored only in this browser, and only if you choose to keep them (see the box below). Attached files are never stored in the browser, only their names and descriptions. The pack and the form data you save are files on your computer, and you send the pack on yourself.
ui.form.keep.label: Keep my answers in this browser, so I can carry on later.
ui.form.keep.labelFile: Keep my answers in this browser. Other pages opened from this computer could read them.
ui.form.keep.removed: Your saved answers are removed from this browser. What is on this page is not saved any more. Tick the box again to keep your answers.
ui.form.privacy.confirm: Delete all saved answers and files in this browser and start over?
ui.form.privacy.cleared: The saved data is deleted. The form is empty.
ui.form.setup.title: About you
ui.form.setup.name: Your name
ui.form.setup.recipient: Who will you send the pack to? (optional)
ui.form.setup.depth: How much do you want to answer?
ui.form.import.label: Continue from a saved file
ui.form.import.hint: If you saved form data on another device, load the file here and carry on where you left off.
ui.form.import.confirm: Replace what is in the form now with the content of the file?
ui.form.nav.title: Sections
ui.form.progress.label: Progress
ui.form.panel.title: Status
ui.form.panel.deferred: Of these, set to be clarified later: {count}
ui.form.save.off: Your answers are not kept in this browser. If you close this page they are gone. Save the form data to a file to keep them.
ui.form.save.savedNoFiles: Saved in this browser at {time}. Attached files are never kept in the browser. Save the form data to a file to keep them.
ui.form.save.failed: Saving in this browser did not work. Save the form data to a file to keep your answers.
ui.form.save.unavailable: This browser cannot save automatically. Save the form data to a file if you want to continue later.
ui.form.save.paused: Not saved. The saved answers were changed in another window.
ui.form.sync.changed: The saved answers in this browser were changed in another window. Saving waits until you choose.
ui.form.sync.keep: Keep what is in this window
ui.form.sync.shown: The answers from the other window are shown.
ui.form.sync.kept: What is in this window is saved. The other window's answers were replaced.
ui.form.sync.unreadable: The saved answers could not be read, so nothing was changed.
ui.form.save.restored: You are continuing where you left off. Your answers were saved in this browser.
ui.form.list.full: This list is full. It can hold at most {max} entries.
ui.form.hint.notUrl: "{item}" does not look like a web address. That is fine, but an address helps.
ui.form.hint.datePast: The date {date} is in the past.
ui.form.unknown.note: What do you know so far? (optional)
ui.form.unknown.needName: Enter the name of the person who can find the answer.
ui.form.unknown.needMyName: Enter your name at the top of the page, so the pack says who will find the answer.
ui.form.files.whatPlaceholder: For example primary logo, black on white
ui.form.files.rightsPlaceholder: For example owned by us, licensed or unknown
ui.form.files.noData: The file is not stored in the browser. Remove it and attach it again if it should be in the pack.
ui.form.files.readError: The file {name} could not be read.
ui.form.files.big: The pack is large. Many mail systems reject files this big, so send it through a shared folder instead.
ui.form.finish.title: Review and download
ui.form.finish.intro: See what is still missing before you download the pack. You can download a pack along the way and come back to change things.
ui.form.finish.noneOpen: Every question in this group is answered.
ui.form.finish.noneDeferred: Nothing is set to be clarified later.
ui.form.finish.needName: Enter your name at the top of the page, so the pack says who answered.
ui.form.finish.sendHint: You get one zip file. Send it on to the person who asked you to fill in the form.
ui.form.finish.sendTo: You get one zip file. Send it to {recipient}.
ui.form.finish.done: The pack was downloaded as {name} ({size}). Look in your downloads folder.
ui.form.finish.removeSaved: Remove my saved answers from this browser
ui.form.finish.removeSavedHint: Do this if other people use this computer. The pack you downloaded is not changed.
ui.form.finish.export: Save form data to a file
ui.form.finish.exportHint: Use the file to carry on from another device. It contains your answers and the files you attached. If the files are very big, only their names are saved and you attach them again.
ui.form.finish.exported: Form data saved to a file.
ui.form.finish.exportedNoFiles: Form data saved to a file. The attached files are too big to go into it, so only their names are in the file. When you load it again, attach these files again: {names}.
ui.form.finish.exportedMissing: Form data saved to a file. These files are not in it, because they are not on this page now: {names}. Attach them again after you load the file.
ui.form.err.nothing: You have not answered anything yet, so there is nothing to download.
ui.form.err.build: The pack could not be built. Save the form data to a file and open the page again.
ui.form.err.tooLarge: The pack is larger than 500 MB and cannot be built. Remove some of the attached files.
ui.form.err.tooManyFiles: The pack has too many files ({count}). The most it can hold is {max}. Remove some of the attached files.
ui.form.err.importFormat: The file was not saved from this form and cannot be loaded.
ui.form.err.importRead: The file could not be read.
ui.form.err.dropped: Answers that cannot be included in the pack ({count}): {questions}. Fix them (they are marked on the page) and download again.
ui.form.err.exportTooLarge: The form data is too large to save to a file in this browser. Remove some of the attached files, or download the pack instead.
ui.form.err.fileName: The file {name} cannot go into the pack because its name is hidden or temporary. Remove it and attach it again under another name.
ui.form.err.fileTooLarge: The answers in {file} take up more than {limit}. Shorten some of the answers and download the pack again.
ui.form.err.importInvalid: The file holds data this form cannot use. Nothing was changed.
ui.form.err.importTooLarge: The file is larger than 400 MB and cannot be loaded. Nothing was changed.
ui.form.err.refresh: The page could not be updated. Save the form data to a file, clear the saved data and open the page again.
ui.form.err.unexpected: Something went wrong. Save the form data to a file and open the page again.
ui.form.files.notSaved: Attached files are not kept in the browser, only their names. If you close this page you attach them again, or you save the form data to a file, which holds them unless they are very big.
ui.form.files.renamed: The file {from} is saved as {name}, because file names in the pack may not hold folder names or hidden or invisible characters.
ui.form.files.tooBig: The file {name} is too big for a pack. A single file can be at most {limit}. It was not attached.
ui.form.files.tooMany: The file {name} was not attached. There can be at most {max} files.
ui.form.files.totalTooBig: The file {name} was not attached. The files in a pack can take up at most {limit} together, and the files already attached leave too little room.
ui.form.finish.leftOut: Left out of the pack: answered questions {answers}, attached files {files}. They belong to questions that the chosen level or your other answers switch off. Choose a fuller level, or change the answer that switches them off, and they are included again.
ui.form.hint.atLimit: The field has reached its maximum length of {max} characters. Anything more is not saved.
ui.form.hint.removed: Hidden characters removed from what you typed or pasted: {count}.
ui.form.import.cleaned: {count} values were changed because they were too long or held characters that cannot be saved.
ui.form.import.ignored: {count} entries do not fit this form and were not loaded.
ui.form.import.reattach: These files came without their content. Attach them again: {names}.
ui.form.import.droppedItems: {count} list entries were left out, because a list holds at most {max} entries.
ui.form.import.droppedFiles: {count} attached files were left out, because a pack holds at most {max} files.
ui.form.privacy.downloadBroken: Download the saved data that could not be read
ui.form.problem.controlChars: The answer holds a character that cannot be saved. Remove it.
ui.form.problem.tooManyRows: The list holds {count} more entries than the {max} it can take. Remove some entries.
ui.form.problem.tooLong: The answer, or a line in it, is too long. A line may have at most 20,000 characters and the whole answer 200 KB. Split the text or shorten it.
ui.form.problem.other: The answer cannot be saved in the pack.
ui.form.save.broken: The data saved in this browser could not be read. The form starts empty. You can download the unreadable data at the top of the page.
